text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hey.
Isn't that taking way too much, no matter how you look at it?
choice_data_list: I don't want anyone thinking I'm some second-rate hack.
I don't want anyone thinking I'm some second-rate hack, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, that was certainly impressive skill.
So that is what they mean by reading the spacing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, what should I do with these?
Maybe bring them as souvenirs for the student council...?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Still, if that's the case... will I be the one carrying them?
An armful of stuffed plushes. All the way to the student council room."
choice_data_list: I bet everyone will be all smiles.
I think everyone will be all smiles.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You're getting a kick out of this, aren't you?
